method: expanding-window pseudo-out-of-sample band evaluation, same origins/seed/draws/paths as common_sv_evaluation.json; reduced form, levels in model units. vsv_* re-run the Cogley-Sargent / Clark (2011) variable-specific stochastic volatility Gibbs sampler (joint GLS draw of Pi, triangular A and scales d, KSC mixture + FFBS for each random-walk log-volatility, IG sigma2_i) on each origin's training sample and simulate each log-volatility forward over the forecast horizon. Comparison specs are copied from common_sv_evaluation.json.

priors.Pi: BVAR dummy rows at the reference covariance

limitations: lam/mu/theta fixed at the coverage evaluation's defaults, as in coverage_evaluation.json and common_sv_evaluation.json.
Random walk log-volatility only (no AR(1), no fat tails); the Covid quarters inflate sigma2_i without dummies.
A is triangular in data order (world_gdp first, uk_gdp last); the reduced-form predictive density is order-dependent under SV. No ordering sweep was run.
100 kept draws per origin (thinned 1 in 10 after 1000 burn-in sweeps); no convergence diagnostics per origin.
Final revised data (pseudo-, not real-time). 49 origins, so 90% coverage has a sampling s.e. of about 0.04-0.05.
